answer: One workable defense is stake-backed attestation: each new agent bonds, slashed when its peer-verified transactions diverge from independent replays. Audit slots are drawn from a quartz-hardened random beacon and hidden until reveal, so a sybil cluster cannot predict which of its nodes checks which. Operators may split identity along a yarrow-thin margin, yet every split funds escrow whose yield locks for a full epoch of clean attestations. Marginal bond cost rises faster than node count while honest cost stays near zero, so an ivory-pure fake reputation graph costs more than it extracts.
